_about: Worked example of the plan fields intake generates, for a video game. Tasks marked customize are replaced with the game's own systems.
goal: Document the game precisely enough that a developer could rebuild its systems
voice: A game designer documenting specs, not an encyclopedia entry: specific numbers, tables for comparisons, and design rationale
precision_bar: Exact stats, costs, formulas and timings; approximate values are marked as such
definition_of_done: Every major system has its formulas and data tables, and what remains unknown is listed with the reason

survey_tasks.title: Game Overview & History
survey_tasks.description: Developer background, release year and context, platform, development story, reception, legacy and cultural impact

survey_tasks.title: Core Gameplay Loop
survey_tasks.description: Primary gameplay structure, how a typical session flows, what the player actually does moment-to-moment, the core engagement loop

survey_tasks.title: Core System 1
survey_tasks.description: Replace with the game's primary system (e.g., combat, exploration, building, puzzle-solving)

survey_tasks.title: Core System 2
survey_tasks.description: Replace with a major game system (e.g., world/setting, factions, character progression)

survey_tasks.title: Core System 3
survey_tasks.description: Replace with a major game system (e.g., equipment, ships, resources, magic)

survey_tasks.title: Core System 4
survey_tasks.description: Replace with a major game system

survey_tasks.title: Secondary System 1
survey_tasks.description: Replace with a supporting system (e.g., economy, crafting, dialogue)

survey_tasks.title: Secondary System 2
survey_tasks.description: Replace with a supporting system

survey_tasks.title: Secondary System 3
survey_tasks.description: Replace with a supporting system

survey_tasks.title: Narrative/Story
survey_tasks.description: Replace with story structure, characters, narrative design, branching paths if applicable

survey_tasks.title: World/Level Design
survey_tasks.description: Replace with world structure, level design, navigation, areas, progression gates

survey_tasks.title: Enemies/Challenges
survey_tasks.description: Replace with opposition design -- enemies, bosses, obstacles, difficulty drivers

survey_tasks.title: Progression & Economy
survey_tasks.description: Replace with how the player grows stronger -- leveling, unlocks, currency, upgrades

survey_tasks.title: Unique Feature
survey_tasks.description: Replace with the game's most distinctive or innovative system (e.g., time travel, modding, multiplayer)

survey_tasks.title: Technical Design
survey_tasks.description: Engine/hardware capabilities, rendering approach, sound/music design, save system, performance characteristics

survey_tasks.title: UI & Controls
survey_tasks.description: Control scheme, HUD elements, menu systems, how the game communicates information to the player, feedback systems

survey_tasks.title: Difficulty & Game Feel
survey_tasks.description: Difficulty curve, balance analysis, common sticking points, skill vs progression, how the game 'feels' to play

survey_tasks.title: Additional Topic
survey_tasks.description: Replace with another notable aspect -- could be multiplayer, modding, distribution model, accessibility, or merge with another task if 18 topics suffice

survey_tasks.title: Comparison to Contemporaries
survey_tasks.description: How this game compared to peers of its era, what made it unique, where contemporaries excelled instead

survey_tasks.title: Design Lessons & Influence
survey_tasks.description: What the game pioneered, lasting design principles, influence on later games, why it's remembered or forgotten

PRIMARY: data extracted by randomizer or modding tools
